visual_impact.instructions: Judge the actual practical impact of the TARGET's presentation under a regenerated-page purpose contract. Does it prevent a person from understanding essential information or identifying/using essential visible controls? Choose non_material when information and controls remain legible and meaningful despite text-only cards, reserved decorative space, a different layout, or cropped illustrative posters whose essential information is provided as readable page text. Choose material when substantial overlap, clipping, unreadability or a broken essential visual makes the target's purpose or essential controls unusable. This is not an aesthetic score and does not require copied source illustrations or layout. Judge visible impact, not hypothetical interactions.

criteria.non_material: Essential information remains understandable and essential visible controls usable.
criteria.material: Presentation makes essential information unintelligible or essential visible controls unusable.
